title: Course Blueprint v5

pedagogical_scope_policy.terminal_targets_source: reviewed target exercises and stronger authority
pedagogical_scope_policy.no_pedagogical_concession_rule: Do not remove useful bounded explanations merely because they exceed the literal wording of the terminal target; distinguish preview, support, and independently required performance.

authority_notes: v5 is the active detailed Year 1 curriculum source after L1.5Q.
Target exercises are the active exercise-first source of truth for independently required paragraph performance.
The pedagogical-boundaries clarification is part of the v5 interpretation contract and distinguishes terminal targets, anticipatory scaffolding, and prerequisite mastery.
Blueprint prose is contextual and design-oriented; it is not sufficient by itself to mint or mutate machine units.
Placeholder records are explicit and must not be treated as reviewed final target exercises.
Book 1 first edition is printed and frozen; genuine repair items are deferred to issue #221 for the second-edition cycle while Book 2 first-edition textbook production remains the active priority.
